title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1673: Carnage unleashed (1)

section.p: Dead?
The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor, a powerful expert who had survived epoch after epoch, had perished.

He had survived from the first epoch all the way to the tenth epoch. He was the first Daofuse the celestial chasms produced since the collapse of the ancient past. He was also the sole Daofuse they had produced all this time.
He had died.
He had died to Great Zhou King.
This was the first Daofuse to die in the past six thousand years.

The Allheaven Battlefield had remained shut for nearly five thousand years. It had been about a thousand years since it reopened. And now, the first Daofuse to perish during this time frame had appeared.
Great Zhou King’s voice spread out of the Celestial Chasm Realm and reverberated everywhere.
“I offer the blood of a Pseudo Emperor to congratulate the new holy lord of humanity. I offer the blood of the celestial chasm race to congratulate humanity.

“Having achieved Daofuse, I killed Soulvenge to celebrate the occasion. Those willing to befriend humanity, you may deploy your experts now. We will forget the past and start anew. Those standing against humanity, take the fate of the celestial chasm race as your warning. In the battle today, humanity won.

“The time has arrived for the myriad races to make a choice. Humanity has survived from the ancient past until now. Nothing can eliminate us. Even a hundred thousand years of defeat have failed to eliminate us. We are still here now. We will still be here a hundred thousand years in the future.”
Great Zhou King’s projection appeared in the sky, visible to all in the Myriad Realms.
Strong.
Very strong.
Humanity had produced its first Daofuse of the tenth epoch.

Nobody knew if he had achieved Daofuse through his willpower cultivation or his physical cultivation. That was not important. The important thing was the fact that he had killed the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor.
Great Zhou King.
The Myriad Realms were shocked.
The minor races were shaken, while the major races were alarmed
What should they do?
The tenth epochal war had begun.
The death of a Daofuse had declared the start of the war.
From now on, even Daofuses would die.
Pseudo Emperors would thus cease being undying figures.
This was the biggest change in this epoch thus far.
Even the laws started shaking.
They were cheering the rise of a new Daofuse.
Great Zhou King’s voice reached the Human Realm as well.
Shock and disbelief spread throughout the Human Realm.
The fortune of Great Zhou surged.
At the same time, the fortune in Su Yu’s crown surged as well.
Su Yu could feel it clearly.
The instant the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor died, the 144th golden stripe appeared on the crown. That was not all. The crown continued growing, slowly approaching the level of a divine weapon.
Strong.
Powerful fortune.
This was a victory for humanity.
With the lives of three Invincibles as the price, a Pseudo Emperor was slain.

Su Yu, who had just killed an Invincible, was soaked with blood. The four Invincibles facing him were also soaked with blood. Disbelief covered their faces as they listened to Great Zhou King’s voice.

This was a victory for humanity. A Daofuse had been slain. A powerful race had been eliminated. The celestial chasms had ceased to exist. The lineage of a powerful race that had survived since the ancient past had ended.
Great Zhou King had advanced into the Daofuse Realm. Cheers rang out everywhere in the Human Realm.
“Victory!”
“Victory!”
Their roars were deafening.
Victory!
Great Zhou King and the others had achieved victory!
They had killed a Pseudo Emperor!
The battle in the Human Realm had yet to end. Many humans had died. But that was not enough to suppress the joy all humans were feeling.
“Hahaha!”
Su Yu was also laughing heartily. As his crown surged in strength, he swung his blade, severing the head of an Invincible.
Crimson clouds covered the sky.
Only three remained.
Up until now, Su Yu had killed six Invincibles. But he had also sustained heavy injuries. Death qi was also flooding out of his body. An indistinct death tunnel was slowly forming underneath him.

With the ancient guardians fighting outside their cities, the level of death qi in his body was already beyond his limit. Meanwhile, the three Invincibles facing him were hurriedly pulling back with sorrowful expressions.
They felt incredibly helpless. Su Yu was too strong. Then again, their battle against Su Yu hadn’t been for nothing. They could see that Su Yu was quite drained from fighting them.
Battles continued raging everywhere.

With twenty-two Invincibles, the enemies still enjoyed an upper hand against humanity in he Human Realm. Even the female furball was finding their superior number difficult to handle. After all, she had exhausted herself instantly killing a seventh-degree Eternal earlier.

This had been a tiring day for her. First, she had to suppress two Eternals. Then, she had to consume one. After that, she forced herself to kill one more. In a short time, she had killed four of them, with three being seventh-degree Eternals and one being a sixth-degree Eternal. These were all top experts. Naturally, Su Yu was counting Snow King and Fire King as his own kills.

At the moment, the female furball was fighting three Eternals alone while Great Zhou King and Heavenly Forge King were fighting one together. The female furball would eventually win, but there was still a seventh-degree Eternal among her three opponents. The other two were sixth-degree Eternals.

Thus, she was starting to get impatient and annoyed. She was very strong. But that was only in comparison with Eternals. Among Daofuses, she was quite young. She wasn’t even a being that had been nurtured into existence by Culture King. Instead, Soy Bun was the one who had nurtured her into existence at the end of the ancient past.

She had met some powerful experts when she was weak, including Culture King, but she had never received any help from them. Thus, a battle of such intensity was enough to drain her. And the more exhausted she was, the angrier she was.
She felt humiliated. As a furball, she had actually wasted so much time fighting a few Eternals. How dare the three weaklings before her fight back instead of running?
They were disrespecting her!
This was such an embarrassment!
The female furball was furious. How dare they look down on her!
She was someone who would eat Tiangu one day!
And thus, the mouth of the furious female furball grew massively, turning into a black hole as she took a big bite, including a large chunk of space itself.
The three Eternals were instantly eaten.
Numerous explosions erupted inside the female furball’s body as the three Eternals resisted inside her body.
That further infuriated the female furball. “How dare you resist?”
This was infuriating!
The soul devourer race had always been ferocious. Thus, the furious furball started shrinking as she compressed her body repeatedly. In the blink of an eye, she became as small as a speck of dust.
Suddenly, a massive rumble sounded.
Crimson clouds covered the sky.
The rain of blood grew heavier.

The three explosions caused the female furball to alternate before enlarging and shrinking. She flew everywhere in the sky, akin to a leaking balloon. She had actually swallowed her three opponents in her fury. Knowing that there was no surviving this, they all detonated themselves.
The series of explosions finally ended after a short while. The female furball returned to her original size with a slightly weakened look in her eyes. The explosions had caused her great discomfort.

The Invincible, who was fighting Great Zhou King and Heavenly Forge King alone, turned around and fled without any hesitation. Out of five of them, the female furball had killed four alone. Even if the female furball was looking quite weak at the moment, he didn’t have the courage to continue fighting.
Junior Zhou King and Heavenly Forge King gave chase. They couldn’t allow an enemy Invincible to run free in the Human Realm. This was too dangerous.
Their side had achieved victory. However, that was only a partial victory.

Moments earlier, when Su Yu was killing an Invincible and the female furball was eating three Invincibles, a sigh rang out. Then, an explosion erupted. Of the three old Invincibles fighting alongside Yun Chen’s group, one sighed before detonating himself.
The explosion forced an enemy Invincible to split into three bodies. Their group was having it the hardest. They had to face seven Invincibles.

They had seven in their group as well, but only five among them were Invincibles and two were Pseudo Invincibles. Furthermore, they were weaker than their seven opponents. That was especially true for the two Pseudo Invincibles. The three old Invincibles were quite weak as well, but that was mainly due to their old injuries.
Yes, Great Qin King had provided them with some carrier treasures for recovery, but they needed time for that. Thus, they had been suppressed by their opponents since the start of the battle.
Seeing that he was on the verge of being killed, one of the human Invincibles detonated himself. If he must die, he wouldn’t die worthlessly.
The female furball had obtained victory.
Su Yu was near victory as well.
Even further away, Great Yuan King had killed yet another Invincible. But he still had two opponents, so it was unlikely that he could help.
Suddenly, the fortune in Su Yu’s crown stirred.
Human Realm.
Great Zheng, one of the thirty-six prefectures, shook violently.
Great Zheng King!
The dead Invincible was a founding king!
The Great Zheng prefect, who was fighting some Sunmoons, teared up as he killed a random Sunmoon with his blade before dropping to his knees. “Father!”

The dead Invincible was his father. Many years ago, Great Zheng King had lost two of his bodies. Even the third body was barely hanging on to life. Thus, he had retired from public life for many years.
Some even believed that he had died.
But the Great Zheng prefect knew that his father was not dead.
Alas, his father had died for real.
Too many enemy Invincibles were hiding in the Human Realm. Death was unavoidable.
As a weakened Invincible with only one body left, his father became the first founding king to die in the Human Realm.
Great Zheng King!
Great Wei, Great Wu, Great Qi, Great Chen, Great Liang, Great Yue, and Great Zheng. Seven of the thirty-six founding kings had died.
Back then, there were more than thirty-six Invincibles among the human race.

Initially, over fifty human Invincibles had walked out of the various ruins. Some had died, leaving thirty-six behind to found the thirty-six prefectures. And now, only twenty-nine of these early Invincibles remained.
